title: Spaghetti & Spinach with Sun-Dried Tomato Cream Sauce
recipe_text:
Recipe: Spaghetti & Spinach with Sun-Dried Tomato Cream Sauce
Yield: 4
Total time: 20m

Ingredients:
  - 5 ounces baby spinach, coarsely chopped
  - 8 ounces whole-wheat spaghetti
  - 1 tablespoon oil from sun-dried tomato jar
  - .5 cup slivered oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, plus 1 tablespoon oil from the jar
  - 0.5 cup halved and thinly sliced onion
  - 3 cloves garlic, minced
  - 0.25 teaspoon crushed red pepper
  - 0.25 teaspoon salt
  - 0.25 teaspoon ground pepper
  - 1 cup low-sodium vegetable or chicken broth
  - 0.5 cup sour cream
  - 0.25 cup grated Parmesan cheese
  - 1 tablespoon unsalted butter

Instructions:
  1. Place 5 ounces spinach in a large colander in the sink. Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil over high heat. Add 8 ounces spaghetti and cook according to package directions. Drain the pasta over the spinach; toss to wilt the spinach.  [image: https://www.eatingwell.com/thmb/A85XqfppKKCTrNdm8CaAueTgnZs=/1500x0/filters:no_upscale():max_bytes(150000):strip_icc()/7919563-spaghetti-spinach-with-sun-dried-tomato-cream-sauce-step-2-388da71c5caa4924b44864f07da36e6e.jpg]
  2. Meanwhile, heat ½ cup sun-dried tomatoes along with 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add ½ cup onion and sun-dried tomatoes; cook, stirring, until softened, about 3 minutes. Add garlic, ¼ teaspoon crushed red pepper, ¼ teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon pepper; cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Increase heat to medium-high and add 1 cup broth; cook, stirring, until reduced by about half, about 2 minutes. Stir in ½ cup sour cream, ¼ cup Parmesan and 1 tablespoon butter. Add the spaghetti and spinach; toss to coat well.  [image: https://www.eatingwell.com/thmb/EujRIPyRqlpWQNvkJUgyBN9Xoeo=/1500x0/filters:no_upscale():max_bytes(150000):strip_icc()/spaghetti-and-spinach-with-sun-dried-tomato-cream-sauce-98bd4c19277a4cb3926e072fd6f2d947.jpg]

Description: In this sun-dried tomato pasta recipe, we use the oil from sun-dried tomatoes for the base of the cream sauce. Serve with a green salad for dinner.
